text: Regarding the hold on contract PMC/BR/2026-27/114, we are reviewing the scour assessment in Appendix D.4 against IRC:78 Clause 703.3.1. Could you please clarify if the current flag relates to the return period used in the scour computation (1-in-50 vs 1-in-100 years) or the discharge value?

We have identified a discrepancy between the Design Report (which specifies a design flood of 2,450 cms) and the Scour Assessment in Appendix D.4 (which uses a peak discharge of 2,180 cms based on a 1-in-50 year return period). We suspect this inconsistency is the cause of the current flag and hold. We are updating the scour computations to align with the design flood of 2,450 cms and will resubmit the package.
